_comment: The harbour by the players' camp on an island map (#454): a jetty from the shore out to the map's harbour spot (MapShape.harbour), and a few things standing about it, as voxel kit pieces. Where it goes is the map's; what it is built of is this file's, and the server and every client must have the same, as its collision comes from it. jetty: the deck stands freeboard metres over the sea; its shore end is where the ground first comes within step metres under the deck (no further than landing metres in from the waterline), so a player walks straight on; it runs out past the map's harbour end to a whole number of 3 m sections; params are the jetty generator's (width, wear, voxel). pieces: each a voxel kit generator with its params, standing at [x, z] metres from an anchor (shore: the jetty's shore end, end: its sea end), x to the right looking out to sea and z out to sea, turned yaw degrees; a land piece is set sink metres into the ground under its lowest corner (and left out where the ground rises more than max_rise metres across it), a floating one (afloat: true, a boat only) has its waterline at the sea's surface. Everything stands inside the harbour's footprint (the map recipe's settlements.harbour.size round the waterline), which roads, sites, power and trees keep off: keep landing plus how far a piece reaches in from the shore end within half of it.
